notes.title: The Story of Exile: A Fight for Survival
notes.content:
You once had a place in the world. A home. A tribe. A life built on the unspoken trust that everyone had a role to play. No one could afford to be weak—because weakness, in a world like this, was the difference between survival and extinction.

Then, you failed.

Maybe it was a moment of hesitation. Maybe it was a choice that, in hindsight, seemed obvious. Maybe it was just bad luck. It doesn’t matter. What matters is that the elders looked at you, weighed the risk, and made their decision.

Exile.

Not a death sentence, but a test. If you can survive alone, endure the relentless land, and prove your strength, you may be allowed to return. But this land was not chosen at random. It is hostile, untamed, and merciless. It shifts with the seasons, testing not just your body, but your mind.

You will scrape by, at first. You will fight to find food, shelter, resources and a way forward. You will make mistakes, and some of them will cost you dearly. But you will learn. With time, you will adapt, mastering the land that once threatened to break you.

Then, when you finally stand on solid ground, when the wilderness no longer feels like a prison but a proving ground, the real question will emerge.

Was this ever about returning? Or have you become something else entirely?

The trial begins soon. Will you survive it?

Wishlist Seasons of Solitude to follow the journey.

Oh, and one more thing—our new Steam capsule art is live! The game’s key visuals now better reflect the world, its dangers, and the journey ahead. Check it out on the store page, and let us know what you think!

— The Seasons of Solitude Team

notes.title: Into the Fog: A New Layer of Strategy
notes.content:
This month, we’re highlighting a feature that’s transforming exploration in Seasons of Solitude: Fog of War.

[h1]A World Waiting to Be Discovered[/h1]

In Seasons of Solitude, every step forward uncovers new possibilities—or unexpected challenges. That distant tile might hold vital resources or conceal hidden dangers. Fog of War adds mystery and strategy to every run, making each decision impactful.

[h1]Exploration in Action[/h1]

[h2]What lies beyond the fog?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296960/4759a53320ed6df97bf05ab015c6b9c7fa25e15b.gif[/img]

How It Works:

1️⃣ Shrouded Terrain: At the start of each run, the map is cloaked in fog. Exploring reveals resources, hazards, and new paths forward.

2️⃣ Strategic Choices: Moving through the fog costs action points. Will you scout thoroughly or take a risk and dive into the unknown?

3️⃣ Visible Danger: Predators move within the fog, but sharp players can spot clues to avoid—or confront—them.

[h1]How It Changes Gameplay[/h1]

What’s exciting is that each level in Seasons of Solitude presents a fresh map with its own unique challenges. Even if you’ve mastered one level, the next one could force you to rethink your strategy. Whether it’s navigating a resource-scarce environment or dealing with aggressive predators, no two runs feel the same. You’ll always need to adapt to the unknown.

We designed Fog of War to reward strategic players. You won’t always know what’s ahead, but if you pay attention, you can spot patterns or clues, like a predator’s movement or where resources are likely to be. It’s not just about reacting to surprises—it’s about staying one step ahead.

We can’t wait to see how you approach this. Will you carefully plan your route or take bold moves to chase rewards? And how will your strategies change with each new level? Let us know—we love hearing your stories!

See you on the frontier,
🌿 The Seasons of Solitude Team

✨ Follow us on [url=https://x.com/NinjarithmGames]X[/url] for sneak peeks, development updates, and more!

notes.title: Core Systems Update: UI, Actions, and Progression
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Survivors![/h1]

We’re excited to share a significant development milestone for Seasons of Solitude! In this update, we’ve established core gameplay systems that will serve as the foundation for your survival journey.

Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Base UI Design[/h2]

The interface in Seasons of Solitude prioritizes clarity and ease of use, allowing players to quickly understand and manage resources, select actions, and monitor survival metrics. Designed with accessibility in mind, it ensures that all key information is clearly presented and easy to navigate, helping players focus on strategic decision-making without unnecessary complexity.

[h2]Action System[/h2]

The Action System is a core mechanic that ensures every choice feels meaningful. Here's how it works:
[list]
    [*][b]Base Actions:[/b] These are actions available to you from the start, such as basic resource gathering or food. They are essential for survival and always accessible.[/*]
    [*][b]Tool-Based Actions:[/b] Unlock more specialized actions by crafting new tools. For example, tools like spears enable hunting, while water purifiers allow you to process contaminated water. These actions expand your capabilities as you progress.[/*]
    [*][b]Durability System:[/b] The availability of certain actions is managed through a durability system, creating strategic trade-offs and encouraging efficient use of resources:
    [olist]
        [*][b]Always Usable:[/b] Some actions, such as basic gathering or water collection, are always available and do not rely on tools or durability limits.[/*]
        [*][b]Auto-Replenishing Durability:[/b] Actions that rely on stamina or natural cycles, like setting traps or scavenging for animal bones, have limited uses per turn but automatically replenish over time, ensuring periodic access.[/*]
        [*][b]Shared Tool Durability:[/b] Advanced actions tied to crafted tools—such as hunting with a spear or processing materials—consume the durability of those tools with each use. Once depleted, the tool must be repaired or replaced to continue using its associated actions.[/*][/olist][/list]

[h2]Progression Tree[/h2]

The progression tree in Seasons of Solitude is designed to guide players through gradual growth while offering meaningful choices that enhance their survival capabilities. It features four distinct categories, each focusing on a different aspect of prehistoric survival:

[list]
    [*][b]Enhanced Gathering[/b]: Unlock upgrades that improve your efficiency in collecting essential resources like food, water, and raw materials. Examples include increased resource yields, faster gathering, or unlocking access to rare biome-specific resources.[/*]
    [*][b]Hunting & Trapping[/b]: Gain advanced techniques and tools to secure food more effectively. Unlock better traps, enhance your ability to hunt larger prey, and utilize hunted animals for crafting or survival needs.[/*]
    [*][b]Resource Tools[/b]: Craft specialized tools to process resources more efficiently. Examples include sharpening stones for tool maintenance, crafting stations for advanced items, or tools to extract rare materials from specific biomes.[/*]
    [*][b]Survival Upgrades[/b]: Unlock critical skills and techniques to survive harsh environments. Examples include building fire pits to cook food, crafting insulated shelters, or improving stamina and recovery rates.[/*][/list]

Many unlocks within the progression tree serve as prerequisites for advanced capabilities, creating a logical flow of growth. For instance, crafting a basic spear might lead to unlocking advanced hunting techniques, while gathering upgrades could expand access to rare biome-specific resources. The system is designed to reward thoughtful planning, allowing players to specialize in areas that suit their survival strategy.

These systems are critical building blocks as we continue to shape [i]Seasons of Solitude[/i] into a strategic survival experience. Check out the screenshots below for a sneak peek into the game’s current state, and stay tuned for more updates as we refine and expand these features.

[b]Thank you for following our journey. Your support inspires us to keep pushing forward![/b]

[b]Wishlist now and be the first to survive the untamed prehistoric wilds.[/b] 🌿🔥
